title: Automatic Legacy-System Reconstructor — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Infers documented behavior from old software and builds tested replacements. A proposed tool for the legacy-code problem: it observes an old system — its inputs, outputs, timing, error behavior, and data formats — infers a documented behavioral specification, and builds a modern tested replacement that reproduces the observed behavior. The reconstruction is verified by differential testing against the original.
capabilities: Observe legacy inputs, outputs, timing, and errors
Infer a documented behavioral specification
Build a modern replacement implementing the spec
Verify by differential testing against the original
Flag behaviors that cannot be safely reproduced
